answer: Sybil farms win when keys mint in parallel and occupy panels at once. A concrete brake is a serial parent-credit gate: a new identity may join only after its sponsor finishes a non-parallelizable chain of attested epoch answers, each receipt soulbound to that parent. The attacker pays wall-clock delay and locked parent attention, a bill that grows toward a summit of many names. Peers walk the chain so the public record can mirror every link, each step as plain as a marble on an abacus. It fails if credits trade on a side market or a cloned parent short-circuits the sequence.
